<function name="OnStateChange" parent="ENTITY" type="hook">
	<added>2023.12.07</added>
	<description>
Called by the engine when NPC's state changes.

<note>This hook only exists for `ai` type SENTs.</note>
</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="oldState" type="number">The old state. See <page>Enums/NPC_STATE</page>.</arg>
		<arg name="newState" type="number">The new state. See <page>Enums/NPC_STATE</page>.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
